rulesStrings.li: timedBombsAdvice(timedBombsCountAdvice==1)->\n\nThis mission will require (*ColonistCount)timed bomb(/ColonistCount) to destroy target.

timedBombsAdvice(timedBombsCountAdvice>1)->\n\nThis mission will require (*ColonistCount)1 timed bomb(/ColonistCount) to destroy last target, but you would like to have [timedBombsCountAdvice] to destroy all targets fast.
